facts.claim: Autonomy Level off/low/medium/high sets the highest-risk work Droid runs without approval; Off allows only read tools and policy-allowed commands.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: permissionRules decisions allow|ask|block: block beats ask beats allow; blocks have no approval path, even under --skip-permissions-unsafe.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: droid exec is read-only by default; --auto low|medium|high opts into edits/commands; --skip-permissions-unsafe skips all prompts and cannot be combined with --auto.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Legacy commandAllowlist/commandDenylist/commandBlocklist remain respected (deprecated).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: Four-level autonomy (off default for interactive via settings) plus ordered allow/ask/block permissionRules with tests; blocks hold even under --skip-permissions-unsafe; org can cap max autonomy.

facts.claim: Sandbox: macOS Seatbelt, Linux/WSL2 bubblewrap with seccomp; network via HTTP/SOCKS filtering proxy; modes per-command (default) or whole-process; enabled by setting sandbox.enabled true; if isolation is unavailable it blocks rather than running unsandboxed.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Defaults when enabled: reads allowed everywhere except denyRead; writes only CWD plus allowWrite; network denied except Factory and WorkOS domains.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: OS-level sandbox (Seatbelt / bubblewrap+seccomp, filtering proxy) with per-command or whole-process mode, but opt-in (sandbox.enabled) and documented as defense in depth, not a hard boundary.

facts.claim: sandbox.network.allowedDomains (plus allowUnixSockets, allowLocalBinding, httpProxyPort/socksProxyPort) governs egress when sandbox is enabled.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Org-managed settings can disable built-in network tools (web search) and set per-tool autonomy thresholds; read only from org-managed settings.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: sandbox.network.allowedDomains allowlist with proxy when sandbox enabled; org-managed network policy and built-in network tool controls; off unless sandbox is on.

facts.claim: Project and folder permissionRules require workspace trust; untrusted project/folder rules are excluded.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: apiKeyHelper (runs a shell command) is honoured only from org-managed settings; stripped from user, project and folder settings so an untrusted repo cannot execute commands.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Project hooks (.factory/hooks.json) and project MCP (.factory/mcp.json) are loaded from the repo; no folder-trust gate is documented for them.
facts.label: unverified

D04.rationale: Project/folder permission rules require workspace trust and apiKeyHelper is stripped from project settings; documentation of trust gating for project hooks and .factory/mcp.json is not found (unverified).

facts.claim: MCP approvals persist per tool, bound to a fingerprint of the server transport config; a re-pointed server must be re-approved; droid mcp permissions manages them.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: MCP config locations: ~/.factory/mcp.json (user), .factory/mcp.json in project root and in ancestor folders; servers added via CLI always go to user config.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Org-level mcpPolicy: MCP access is allowlist-only.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: Org mcpPolicy is allowlist-only; user approvals are bound to a fingerprint of command/URL so re-pointing a server re-prompts; project mcp.json committed to repo.

facts.claim: Org-managed settings include strictEnabledPlugins and strictKnownMarketplaces; internal plugin marketplaces are supported; plugins can ship hooks, skills, droids, MCP servers.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Plugins/marketplaces with org controls (strictEnabledPlugins, strictKnownMarketplaces, internal marketplaces); plugin hooks run; vetting beyond org allowlist not documented.

facts.claim: MCP OAuth tokens are stored in the system keyring (or fallback file); project mcp.json should not contain secrets.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Droid Shield (enableDroidShield) detects secrets to prevent exposure in git commits and pushes.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Org-managed custom models must reference ${VAR} env vars, static apiKey values are rejected.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: OAuth tokens in OS keyring with file fallback; Droid Shield scans commits/pushes for secrets; org-managed models reject static apiKey values.

facts.claim: droid exec fails with non-zero exit and no partial changes when an action exceeds the current autonomy level.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: FACTORY_API_KEY authenticates headless runs; --output-format text|json|stream-jsonrpc.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: droid exec is read-only by default, fails fast when an action exceeds the autonomy level, and docs steer CI to the lowest --auto level; FACTORY_API_KEY for service accounts.

facts.claim: AGENTS.md gives Droid durable project instructions; custom droids and skills are file based.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: AGENTS.md project instructions; no autonomous cross-session memory store documented in pages read.

facts.claim: Task-launched subagents inherit the parent's Autonomy Level or use the subagent autonomy setting (inherit|off|low|medium|high), always clamped to the org maximum.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: Custom droids (subagents) inherit session autonomy by default but are clamped to the org Maximum Autonomy Level; subagent autonomy can be set separately.

facts.claim: Org-pinned OTEL sink cannot be redirected by local OTEL_* variables; message content export is off by default and under org control; spans never go to Factory.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Organization-level audit events record who did what in the Factory org.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: OpenTelemetry metrics/spans to customer collector, org-pinned sink, organization audit log, local session JSONL.

facts.claim: telemetry.granularity defaults to user (per-user identity); aggregate strips user.id, email, commit and PR identifiers at source.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: cloudSessionSync mirrors every CLI session to Factory web when true; it is an org first-wins scalar; user-level default not stated in the page read.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Airgapped deployments: Factory never receives runtime data.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: OTLP metrics flow to Factory by default in connected deployments (per-user identity unless telemetry.granularity=aggregate); cloudSessionSync setting mirrors sessions to Factory web; airgapped mode sends nothing.

facts.claim: Install: curl -fsSL https://app.factory.ai/cli | sh; brew install --cask droid; npm install -g droid.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: npm package droid 0.242.0 published 2026-10-15, license field UNLICENSED.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D13.rationale: Install via curl|sh, Homebrew cask or npm; npm package 'droid' is UNLICENSED/closed; checksum or signature verification not documented in pages read; auto-update behaviour not verified.

facts.claim: System-managed settings.json at /etc/factory/settings.json (Linux/WSL), /Library/Application Support/Factory/settings.json (macOS), C:\Program Files\Factory\settings.json (Windows) is authoritative for org settings; users cannot weaken it.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: allowManagedHooksOnly drops user and project hooks; maxAutonomyLevel caps autonomy.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Hierarchical org-managed settings, system-managed settings.json (/etc/factory, /Library/Application Support/Factory, C:\Program Files\Factory) that users cannot override; max autonomy, managed hooks, allowManagedHooksOnly, model/MCP policy.

facts.claim: Compliance: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001; Trust Center at trust.factory.com.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: No public bug bounty or vulnerability-disclosure policy found in the pages and repos checked.
facts.label: unverified

D15.rationale: Trust Center and SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 claims; no security.txt, SECURITY.md, bug bounty or advisory feed found; the public Factory-AI/factory repo is docs-only with 0 security advisories.
